lemmas.name: lengthOfLIS_ok
lemmas.statement: ∀ (nums : List Int) (h : lengthOfLIS_precond nums), lengthOfLIS_postcond nums (let allSubseq := (nums.foldl fun acc x => acc ++ acc.map (fun sub => x :: sub)) [[]] |>.map List.reverse; let increasingSubseqLens := allSubseq.filter (fun l => List.Pairwise (· < ·) l) |>.map (·.length); increasingSubseqLens.foldl max 0) h
lemmas.proof:
by intro nums h
  unfold lengthOfLIS_postcond
  exact Refine.maxlist_nat _ (List.ne_nil_of_mem (a := 0) (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨[], List.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Refine.allsub_rev_nil_mem nums, by simp⟩, rfl⟩))
